confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July peak-season demand, location and booking window. Cocktail and wine were set against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine glass about 1.2x beer). FX is the most recent RBA figure I could tie to an rba.gov.au page via search summaries (2026-03-20, about seven months before the generation date). October 2026 figures in search summaries could not be verified and were not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to general knowledge of Athens price levels and to other summer-peak southern European capitals such as Lisbon and Rome; no live listings were consulted.
